notes: Alpha.12 rebuilds Runtime startup as a six-stage observable pipeline. Existing Web profiles are upgraded offline and atomically on the Android host; startup no longer invokes dsh plugin or pnpm for bundled mobile plugins. Disk inventory is authoritative, stale telemetry is reset, and Chat surfaces service-stage failures promptly instead of spinning for minutes. Robolectric and ARM64 Runtime E2E cover old-profile migration and real DSH Web startup. OriginOS cover-install remains a manual device check.
